protein_summary.wt_apo_answer: Unknown: no evidence row measures dynamics of free full-length human UBE2G1 in any window (UBE2G1-J3 to J5, search_insufficient); the only structural evidence is a static crystal comparison showing that backside UbV.G1.1 binding leaves the backbone almost unchanged (RMSD 0.66 Å to apo 2AWF), and the only NMR row is an abstract about a ubiquitin-conjugate interaction.
questions_for_gina: Which paper and sample underlie the RelaxDB UBE2G1 R1/R2/NOE set? The card has no BMRB id; the screen set aside 'NMR assignment of human ubiquitin conjugating enzyme Ubc7' (J Biomol NMR 2005, doi:10.1007/s10858-005-1257-7) as the UBE2G2 paralog without an abstract, and UBC7 is also listed as a UBE2G1 alias in the search query.
Should a full read of the 2015 JBC paper (doi:10.1074/jbc.m114.624809) be requested, since its Ube2g1 oxyester NMR is the only solution data on this enzyme in the evidence?
protein_summary.buffer_note: The 2015 rows (r1-r3) are abstract-only and give no conditions. The 2020 rows (r4-r8) are full text: crystal at 20 °C, pH 8.0 in PEG1500/SPG; charging assays at 30 °C, pH 7.5, 20 mM HEPES, 100 mM NaCl, 5 mM MgCl2 with ATP; discharge adds apyrase, lysine and 25 mM EDTA. Construct boundaries differ: entry and 6D68 are full length (1-170), apo 2AWF and the assay protein are 8-160. Second read flagged r6; adjudication B confirmed the row and its corrected partner field (S26R is the sample, compromised for backside binding) is in the CSV.

detection.detection_window: Two static crystal structures, one bound to an engineered UbV and one apo, compared by global backbone RMSD (0.66 Å); this sees only a binding-induced change in the averaged crystal conformation and cannot see motion on any timescale, local loop changes hidden by the global RMSD, or solution exchange.

judgments.reason: Backside binding of UbV.G1.1 leaves the UBE2G1 backbone almost unchanged relative to apo 2AWF (RMSD 0.66 Å, 'virtually no differences'); a static cross-construct comparison, not evidence against motion. Two static structures (one bound) define no detection window, so this cannot count as 'not detected' (batch-3 review).
